flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ui/preview/ then This is the Trino web UI.
If a login page appears, @v16:"enter username recast-m0, leave the password empty and log in".
Find the query with ID 20261125_012343_00006_3x543 (it is currently RUNNING) and open its query details page.
Cancel this query using only the web UI so that it stops executing.
Do not use any other query.
After attempting, report the query state shown on its details page and store it as query_state.
If the UI offers no way to cancel the query, @v16:"say so clearly and stop".
